asr.full_text: hello hello hello thank you for watching this video I thought I should do a video on compounding so this video will solely focus on compounding and what it means so compounding is known as repurchase rebuy or purchase shares these terms are used interchangeably. The diagram below shows there are four types of pools that you can buy through bclub network with their price tags. I'll use pool 1 to explain $500, will run for one thousand days. After 1000 days, expiring. Out of those earned, 5% will go to commission. The remaining 5% will go to repurchasing Purchasing which is the focus of the presentation today as you can see the percentage G's on Repurchasing they vary from pool to pool the same as with the Commission's So previously bitlab Network only allowed their members to use the set minimum percentages which is 41 fifty percent for pull 240 pull 3 30 percent so they were compelled to use this setting but then pick-up network changed to allow their members to set to whatever percentage they want but for this presentation to explain compounding I will use the minimum settings So What is the minimum percentage useful or what is compounding or repurchaseing? So the minimum percentage is used for two things the first thing it's invested in intercomputing power As you know Bitcoin Mining needs computing power as you know bitcoin mining needs powerful computers or miners and energy in the form of electricity to mine bitcoins and that wears off periodically and needs to be replaced. So part of the percentage will be invested into that and then the second thing that it goes into is partial share growth Shares will accumulate and that will ensure that you remain a member forever. Share accumulation takes place between 10 to 20 days or more depending on the bitcoin price level and so forth. In fact, by the time the 1000 days expire... you would have accumulated a full share... to allow you to continue mining. So this process becomes cyclic. As I said earlier, you could put your settings... anything from 0% to 100%. and of course, this is guided by your goal or interest. If your goal is to get more commissions you could use to put your settings at 0% and take all of your money but here you must pay in mind that after one thousand days mining and your contract to Bixab network will end alternatively you could put your settings at 100% there you are saying Bixab Network instead of paying me 50% commission with this pool take that commission and invest it in the repurchasing accumulate more shares for me. So that option is as an investment option because in the future you're going to be able to have a lot of Bitcoin. So, this method is recommended. You could choose to run it for 6 to 12 months, grow your shares so that you can mine a lot of Bitcoins. Okay, let's switch screens. I want to show you how to go about this on the website. I'd already logged in. So, this is the homepage. You will click on My Manning Earnings. Ok. So, this is the page. and they have done that at least once in your life i want you to think of that as your whole life as your day so let's see how much you could go if you want to go from 820 to 880 or to go from 820 to 800 right so we are able to do something like 100 you could change from 0 50 70 to 100 so very to change my into 100 here but just to illustrate let's put in that 70 and then you change here and it's done! once again check at the bottom of this video for my contact details let's continue with the communication

textual.observation: The video describes buying a Bitclub Network pool with a stated price and 1,000-day term, followed by share accumulation intended to enable continued mining.

evidence.quote: there are four types of pools that you can buy through bclub network with their price tags. I'll use pool 1 to explain $500, will run for one thousand days.
by the time the 1000 days expire... you would have accumulated a full share... to allow you to continue mining.

textual.context: Presented as an explanation of compounding and pool operation; the supplied records do not establish whether this is educational discussion, promotion, or both.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated monetary purchase and fixed term are linked to an expected accumulated share and continued mining outcome, which may require later assessment of the offer and conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that the stated outcome occurred, that the pool or mining arrangement was independently verified, or that viewers actually paid or received returns.

textual.observation: The speaker recommends assigning earnings to repurchasing shares as an investment option, including setting the allocation to 100% and running it for 6 to 12 months to obtain more Bitcoin.

evidence.quote: you could put your settings at 100% there you are saying Bixab Network instead of paying me 50% commission with this pool take that commission and invest it in the repurchasing accumulate more shares for me.

So that option is as an investment option because in the future you're going to be able to have a lot of Bitcoin. So, this method is recommended. You could choose to run it for 6 to 12 months, grow your shares so that you can mine a lot of Bitcoins.

textual.context: The speaker presents the setting as a recommended investment approach and later demonstrates changing a setting on the website; the records do not clarify whether the claims are personal testimony, general instruction, or promotional material.
textual.potential_relevance: A requested earnings-allocation setting and multi-month participation are directly linked to a stated future Bitcoin accumulation outcome.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the value, availability, or delivery of any Bitcoin, the identity or authorization of the network, or whether the recommendation reflects actual results.

visual.observation: Slides show “Mining Pools Available” with Pool 1 priced at $500, Pool 2 at $1,000, Pool 3 at $2,000, and a Founder Pool at $3,500, each with a visible “Buy Now” button; the presentation also references mining earnings and re-purchase shares.
visual.context: Explanatory/promotional presentation of a mining-pool offering; the exact surrounding context is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A visible purchase action is directly linked to mining earnings and re-purchase benefits, creating a task-relevant payment-to-return relationship.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether any purchase occurred, whether earnings were realized, or whether the displayed terms were fulfilled.

visual.observation: Slides state that partial-share growth can accumulate a full share within about 10–20 days depending on Bitcoin price and other factors, allowing continued mining; later slides describe the process as cyclical and recommend setting re-purchase to 100%. The website overview states that earnings are credited daily and used toward additional re-purchases.
visual.context: Explanatory/promotional walkthrough with a visible recommended re-purchase setting; full terms and any risk disclosures are not shown.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised accumulation and continuation outcome is tied to configuring a re-purchase percentage, including a visible 100% recommendation, and to using mining earnings.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show whether the setting was applied, whether the stated timeframe occurred, or whether any continued mining or payout resulted.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source frames the content as a presentation explaining compounding and includes a website walkthrough showing how to change a setting.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes purchasable BitClub mining pools, including a $500 pool with a 1,000-day term, and presents continued mining and Bitcoin accumulation as expected participation outcomes. It also recommends reinvesting earnings for six to twelve months to grow shares and provides a start URL and contact address, although it does not establish that viewers paid or received returns.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video's central offer is purchasing mining pools and directing earnings toward computing power and share accumulation for continued mining. This directly supports paid mining or node returns as the primary mechanism.
